verdict.rationale: Codegen documents its own monitoring surfaces: an Agent Run Logs API exposing the agent's thought process, tool usage and execution flow; a TUI for viewing runs; and CLI telemetry with traces in the web UI. Agents can also report progress in Slack. None of these sources clearly says the view is live while the run is in progress, and current status is only implied by pause/resume. Missing for 10: explicit real-time or streaming observation of a running agent, a documented current-status field or view, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can watch what a running agent is doing in real time, including its current status

citations.quote: The Agent Run Logs API allows you to retrieve detailed execution logs for agent runs, providing insights into the agent's thought process, tool usage, and execution flow.
